headline: Zaqatala district with high forest cover and strong educational infrastructure.

tags.reason: The area features 37.2 percent forest cover and 7.18 parks per 10,000 residents compared to the national median of 3.89.

summary: Zaqatala has a population of 130,900 and a density of 97 residents per square kilometre. The district offers robust educational and healthcare infrastructure with 8.71 schools and 1.15 hospitals per 10,000 residents. Nature indices are high at 78 out of 100, supported by 37.2 percent forest cover and a PM2.5 level of 11.5. Transport infrastructure shows lower coverage with 0.23 bus stops per 10,000 residents and an infrastructure index of 43 out of 100. Price data for real estate listings are currently unavailable in this dataset.
